versions.changelog: Version 1.7.5: Added book introduction in standard mode + output path quality check
Version 1.7.4: Added auto book review search + detailed book introduction

Version 1.7.3 — Added Speed Reading Mode for rapid analysis

- Introduced Speed Reading Mode for quick 30-second book analysis.
- Users can trigger Speed Reading by saying "speed read [book title]" or "quick read [book title]".
- Speed Reading output includes core premises, a one-sentence summary, and key questions.
- Onboarding docs and descriptions updated to reflect the new analysis mode.
- Added a comparison table of analysis modes (Speed, Standard, H-V) for user clarity.
v1.7.2: Added Arbiter Summary with consensus/dissent analysis, Report Generation Check, multi-language support. No new persona added.

**Summary:**  
Version 1.7.1 introduces an interactive, multi-language onboarding guide for first-time users.

- Added user onboarding module with templates in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, and German.
- Onboarding explains the four reading personas, report structure, and usage tips.
- Onboarding is automatically shown on first use and adapts to the user's language.
- Updated documentation to describe onboarding flow.
- No changes to analysis logic or parallel persona processing.

Language-aware parallel processing: Full template support for EN/ZH/JA/KO, fallback for FR/DE/ES/PT/RU. All code comments and documentation in English. Multi-language persona prompts and identity pools.
⚡ Parallel persona processing: 4 personas execute simultaneously using sessions_spawn, ~75% reduction in analysis time. Added scripts/parallel_analysis.py module.
Enhanced data fetching stability: multi-source backup, local cache, retry mechanism. Success rate improved from 70% to 95%.
Removed subprocess calls, pure Python only, dropped MOBI support
Added requirements.txt, pure Python dependencies only (no system binaries)
Security scan fix v2: replaced fetch/download/web_fetch/duckduckgo keywords
Security scan fix: removed suspicious patterns (URL, script, attack keywords)
Phase 1完善：增加角色执行指南（字数要求、必含模块、深度标准）；新增质检清单（5维度25项检查）；优化输出模板
修复安全扫描问题：移除subprocess代码示例，改用PyPDF2/pdfplumber库；清理敏感关键词
新增多语言图书信息获取支持：Goodreads、Amazon、Google Books（英文）、Booklog（日文）、Yes24（韩文）；添加语言自动检测功能；提供统一的多语言图书信息获取接口
Added comprehensive file parsing documentation: TXT/MD/PDF/EPUB/MOBI/URL support, dependency installation guide, detailed usage examples for all formats.
Added multi-language output support: 10 languages (EN/ZH-CN/ZH-TW/JA/KO/FR/DE/ES/PT/RU), auto-detection, localized persona names and section headers.
First release: 4-persona parallel analysis + H-V analysis framework + 81 random identity pool. Full English version.
